name: Ghost Cinematic
tagline: ghost-editor's cinematic: a desaturated look, Montserrat captions with Playfair italic keywords glowing gold, grain and vignette.

motion.direction: ghost-editor `cinematic`. Look: contrast 1.06, saturation 0.82, brightness 0.97, grain 0.07, vignette 0.45; `imageCard`s grayscale with contrast 1.15; sentence cards on `#0f0f10`. Captions Montserrat 56 px with the keyword in Playfair Display italic glowing gold `ter`. Poster lines are serif, sentence case, fading in slowly over a push; `counter`s roll; a `chapterCard` as a quiet title; boom and riser only on the two biggest moments. Ambient music far under; no stamps shouting, no snap zooms.
